12/// A painter for nearest-neighbor images with no skewing.
13#[derive(Debug)]
14pub(crate) struct PlainNNImagePainter<'a, S: Simd> {
15    data: ImagePainterData<'a, S>,
16    y_positions: f32x4<S>,
17    cur_x_pos: f32x4<S>,
18    advance: f32,
19    simd: S,
20}
21
22impl<'a, S: Simd> PlainNNImagePainter<'a, S> {
23    pub(crate) fn new(simd: S, image: &'a EncodedImage, pixmap: &'a Pixmap, start_x: f64, start_y: f64) -> Self {
24        let data = ImagePainterData::new(simd, image, pixmap, start_x, start_y);
25
26        let y_positions = extend(
27            simd,
28            f32x4::splat_pos(simd, data.cur_pos.y as f32, data.x_advances.1, data.y_advances.1),
29            image.sampler.y_extend,
30            data.height,
31            data.height_inv,
32        );
33
34        let cur_x_pos = f32x4::splat_pos(simd, data.cur_pos.x as f32, data.x_advances.0, data.y_advances.0);
35
36        Self { data, advance: image.x_advance.x as f32, y_positions, cur_x_pos, simd }
37    }
38}
39
40impl<S: Simd> Iterator for PlainNNImagePainter<'_, S> {
41    type Item = u8x16<S>;
42
43    #[inline(always)]
44    fn next(&mut self) -> Option<Self::Item> {
45        let x_pos = extend(self.simd, self.cur_x_pos, self.data.image.sampler.x_extend, self.data.width, self.data.width_inv);
46
47        let samples = sample(self.simd, &self.data, x_pos, self.y_positions);
48
49        self.cur_x_pos += self.advance;
50
51        Some(samples)
52    }
53}

55u8x16_painter!(PlainNNImagePainter<'_, S>);

72impl<S: Simd> Iterator for NNImagePainter<'_, S> {
73    type Item = u8x16<S>;
74
75    fn next(&mut self) -> Option<Self::Item> {
76        let x_positions = extend(
77            self.simd,
78            f32x4::splat_pos(self.simd, self.data.cur_pos.x as f32, self.data.x_advances.0, self.data.y_advances.0),
79            self.data.image.sampler.x_extend,
80            self.data.width,
81            self.data.width_inv,
82        );
83
84        let y_positions = extend(
85            self.simd,
86            f32x4::splat_pos(self.simd, self.data.cur_pos.y as f32, self.data.x_advances.1, self.data.y_advances.1),
87            self.data.image.sampler.y_extend,
88            self.data.height,
89            self.data.height_inv,
90        );
91
92        let samples = sample(self.simd, &self.data, x_positions, y_positions);
93
94        self.data.cur_pos += self.data.image.x_advance;
95
96        Some(samples)
97    }
98}

102/// A painter for images with bilinear or bicubic filtering.
103///
104/// The painter is generic over sampler quality using the const-generic `QUALITY` parameter.
105///
106/// - Set `QUALITY` to `1` for bilinear sampling; or
107/// - set `QUALITY` to `2` for bicubic sampling.
108///
109/// These values for `QUALITY` are the same numeric values as defined by
110/// [`crate::third_party::vello_cpu::peniko::ImageQuality`].
111#[derive(Debug)]
112pub(crate) struct FilteredImagePainter<'a, S: Simd, const QUALITY: u8> {
113    data: ImagePainterData<'a, S>,
114    simd: S,
115}
116
117impl<'a, S: Simd, const QUALITY: u8> FilteredImagePainter<'a, S, QUALITY> {
118    pub(crate) fn new(simd: S, image: &'a EncodedImage, pixmap: &'a Pixmap, start_x: f64, start_y: f64) -> Self {
119        let data = ImagePainterData::new(simd, image, pixmap, start_x, start_y);
120
121        Self { data, simd }
122    }
123}
124
125impl<S: Simd, const QUALITY: u8> Iterator for FilteredImagePainter<'_, S, QUALITY> {
126    type Item = f32x16<S>;
127
128    fn next(&mut self) -> Option<Self::Item> {
129        let x_positions = f32x4::splat_pos(self.simd, self.data.cur_pos.x as f32, self.data.x_advances.0, self.data.y_advances.0);
130
131        let y_positions = f32x4::splat_pos(self.simd, self.data.cur_pos.y as f32, self.data.x_advances.1, self.data.y_advances.1);
132
133        // We have two versions of filtering: `Medium` (bilinear filtering) and
134        // `High` (bicubic filtering).
135
136        // In bilinear filtering, we sample the pixels of the rectangle that spans the
137        // locations (-0.5, -0.5) and (0.5, 0.5), and weight them by the fractional
138        // x/y position using simple linear interpolation in both dimensions.
139        // In bicubic filtering, we instead span a 4x4 grid around the
140        // center of the location we are sampling, and sample those points
141        // using a cubic filter to weight each location's contribution.
142
143        let x_fract = fract_floor(x_positions + 0.5);
144        let y_fract = fract_floor(y_positions + 0.5);
145
146        let mut interpolated_color = f32x16::splat(self.simd, 0.0);
147
148        let sample = |x_pos: f32x4<S>, y_pos: f32x4<S>| u8_to_f32(sample(self.simd, &self.data, x_pos, y_pos));
149
150        macro_rules! extend_x {
151            ($idx:expr,$offsets:expr) => {
152                extend(self.simd, x_positions + $offsets[$idx], self.data.image.sampler.y_extend, self.data.width, self.data.width_inv)
153            };
154        }
155
156        macro_rules! extend_y {
157            ($idx:expr,$offsets:expr) => {
158                extend(self.simd, y_positions + $offsets[$idx], self.data.image.sampler.y_extend, self.data.height, self.data.height_inv)
159            };
160        }
161
162        match QUALITY {
163            // medium quality: bilinear
164            1 => {
165                // <https://github.com/google/skia/blob/220738774f7a0ce4a6c7bd17519a336e5e5dea5b/src/opts/SkRasterPipeline_opts.h#L5039-L5078>
166                let cx = [1.0 - x_fract, x_fract];
167                let cy = [1.0 - y_fract, y_fract];
168
169                // Note that the sum of all cx*cy combinations also yields 1.0 again
170                // (modulo some floating point number impreciseness), ensuring the
171                // colors stay in range.
172
173                const OFFSETS: [f32; 2] = [-0.5, 0.5];
174
175                let x_positions = [extend_x!(0, OFFSETS), extend_x!(1, OFFSETS)];
176
177                let y_positions = [extend_y!(0, OFFSETS), extend_y!(1, OFFSETS)];
178
179                // We sample the corners of rectangle that covers our current position.
180                for x_idx in 0..2 {
181                    let x_positions = x_positions[x_idx];
182
183                    for y_idx in 0..2 {
184                        let y_positions = y_positions[y_idx];
185                        let color_sample = sample(x_positions, y_positions);
186                        let w = element_wise_splat(self.simd, cx[x_idx] * cy[y_idx]);
187
188                        interpolated_color = w.mul_add(color_sample, interpolated_color);
189                    }
190                }
191
192                interpolated_color *= f32x16::splat(self.simd, 1.0 / 255.0);
193            }
194            // high quality: bicubic
195            2 => {
196                // Compare to <https://github.com/google/skia/blob/84ff153b0093fc83f6c77cd10b025c06a12c5604/src/opts/SkRasterPipeline_opts.h#L5030-L5075>.
197                let cx = weights(self.simd, x_fract);
198                let cy = weights(self.simd, y_fract);
199
200                const OFFSETS: [f32; 4] = [-1.5, -0.5, 0.5, 1.5];
201
202                let x_positions = [extend_x!(0, OFFSETS), extend_x!(1, OFFSETS), extend_x!(2, OFFSETS), extend_x!(3, OFFSETS)];
203
204                let y_positions = [extend_y!(0, OFFSETS), extend_y!(1, OFFSETS), extend_y!(2, OFFSETS), extend_y!(3, OFFSETS)];
205
206                // Note in particular that it is guaranteed that, similarly to bilinear filtering,
207                // the sum of all cx*cy is 1 (modulo some edge cases).
208
209                // We sample the 4x4 grid around the position we are currently looking at.
210                for x_idx in 0..4 {
211                    let x_positions = x_positions[x_idx];
212                    for y_idx in 0..4 {
213                        let y_positions = y_positions[y_idx];
214
215                        let color_sample = sample(x_positions, y_positions);
216                        let w = element_wise_splat(self.simd, cx[x_idx] * cy[y_idx]);
217
218                        interpolated_color = w.mul_add(color_sample, interpolated_color);
219                    }
220                }
221
222                interpolated_color *= f32x16::splat(self.simd, 1.0 / 255.0);
223
224                let alphas = interpolated_color.splat_4th();
225
226                // Due to the nature of the cubic filter, it can happen in certain situations
227                // that one of the color components ends up with a higher value than the
228                // alpha component, which isn't permissible because the color is
229                // premultiplied and would lead to overflows when doing source over
230                // compositing with u8-based values. Because of this, we need to clamp
231                // to the alpha value.
232                interpolated_color = interpolated_color.min(alphas).min(f32x16::splat(self.simd, 1.0)).max(f32x16::splat(self.simd, 0.0));
233            }
234            _ => panic!(
235                "Unknown value for `FilteredImagePainter`'s const-generic `QUALITY` parameter. Expected `1` for bilinear or `2` for bicubic, got: `{QUALITY}`."
236            ),
237        }
238
239        self.data.cur_pos += self.data.image.x_advance;
240
241        Some(interpolated_color)
242    }
243}

246f32x16_painter!(FilteredImagePainter<'_, S, 1>);

250/// Computes the positive fractional part of a value: `val - val.floor()`.
251///
252/// Unlike `f32::fract()`, this always returns a value in [0, 1),
253/// even for negative inputs.
254#[inline(always)]
255pub(crate) fn fract_floor<S: Simd>(val: f32x4<S>) -> f32x4<S> {
256    val - val.floor()
257}

259/// Common data used by different image painters
260#[derive(Debug)]
261pub(crate) struct ImagePainterData<'a, S: Simd> {
262    pub(crate) cur_pos: Point,
263    pub(crate) image: &'a EncodedImage,
264    pub(crate) pixmap: &'a Pixmap,
265    pub(crate) x_advances: (f32, f32),
266    pub(crate) y_advances: (f32, f32),
267    pub(crate) height: f32x4<S>,
268    pub(crate) height_inv: f32x4<S>,
269    pub(crate) width: f32x4<S>,
270    pub(crate) width_inv: f32x4<S>,
271    pub(crate) width_u32: u32x4<S>,
272}
273
274impl<'a, S: Simd> ImagePainterData<'a, S> {
275    pub(crate) fn new(simd: S, image: &'a EncodedImage, pixmap: &'a Pixmap, start_x: f64, start_y: f64) -> Self {
276        let width = pixmap.width() as f32;
277        let height = pixmap.height() as f32;
278        let start_pos = image.transform * Point::new(start_x, start_y);
279
280        let width_inv = f32x4::splat(simd, 1.0 / width);
281        let height_inv = f32x4::splat(simd, 1.0 / height);
282        let width = f32x4::splat(simd, width);
283        let width_u32 = u32x4::splat(simd, pixmap.width() as u32);
284        let height = f32x4::splat(simd, height);
285
286        let x_advances = (image.x_advance.x as f32, image.x_advance.y as f32);
287        let y_advances = (image.y_advance.x as f32, image.y_advance.y as f32);
288
289        Self { cur_pos: start_pos, pixmap, x_advances, y_advances, image, width, height, width_u32, width_inv, height_inv }
290    }
291}

293#[inline(always)]
294pub(crate) fn sample<S: Simd>(simd: S, data: &ImagePainterData<'_, S>, x_positions: f32x4<S>, y_positions: f32x4<S>) -> u8x16<S> {
295    let idx = x_positions.to_int::<u32x4<S>>() + y_positions.to_int::<u32x4<S>>() * data.width_u32;
296
297    u32x4::from_slice(
298        simd,
299        &[
300            data.pixmap.sample_idx(idx[0]).to_u32(),
301            data.pixmap.sample_idx(idx[1]).to_u32(),
302            data.pixmap.sample_idx(idx[2]).to_u32(),
303            data.pixmap.sample_idx(idx[3]).to_u32(),
304        ],
305    )
306    .to_bytes()
307}
308
309#[inline(always)]
310pub(crate) fn extend<S: Simd>(
311    simd: S,
312    val: f32x4<S>,
313    extend: crate::third_party::vello_cpu::peniko::Extend,
314    max: f32x4<S>,
315    inv_max: f32x4<S>,
316) -> f32x4<S> {
317    match extend {
318        // Note that max should be exclusive, so subtract one to enforce that.
319        // Since the maximum image dimensions we support is u16::MAX, subtracting 1 in f32
320        // is enough to ensure that all numbers are subtracted correctly.
321        crate::third_party::vello_cpu::peniko::Extend::Pad => val.min(max - 1.0).max(f32x4::splat(simd, 0.0)),
322        crate::third_party::vello_cpu::peniko::Extend::Repeat => {
323            // floor := (val * inv_max).floor() * max is the nearest multiple of `max` below val.
324            max.mul_add(-(val * inv_max).floor(), val)
325                // In certain edge cases, we might still end up with a higher number.
326                .min(max - 1.0)
327        }
328        // <https://github.com/google/skia/blob/220738774f7a0ce4a6c7bd17519a336e5e5dea5b/src/opts/SkRasterPipeline_opts.h#L3274-L3290>
329        crate::third_party::vello_cpu::peniko::Extend::Reflect => {
330            let u = val - (val * inv_max * f32x4::splat(simd, 0.5)).floor() * f32x4::splat(simd, 2.0) * max;
331            let s = (u * inv_max).floor();
332            let m = u - f32x4::splat(simd, 2.0) * s * (u - max);
333
334            let bias_in_ulps = s.trunc();
335
336            let m_bits = u32x4::from_bytes(m.to_bytes());
337            // This would yield NaN if `m` is 0 and `bias_in_ulps` > 0, but since
338            // our `max` is always an integer number, u and s must also be an integer number
339            // and thus `m_bits` must be 0.
340            // Note that this is a wrapping sub!
341            let biased_bits = m_bits - bias_in_ulps.to_int::<u32x4<S>>();
342            f32x4::from_bytes(biased_bits.to_bytes())
343                // In certain edge cases, we might still end up with a higher number.
344                .min(max - 1.0)
345        }
346    }
347}

349/// Calculate the weights for a single fractional value.
350fn weights<S: Simd>(simd: S, fract: f32x4<S>) -> [f32x4<S>; 4] {
351    simd.vectorize(
352        #[inline(always)]
353        || {
354            let s = fract.simd;
355            const MF: [[f32; 4]; 4] = mf_resampler();
356
357            [
358                single_weight(fract, f32x4::splat(s, MF[0][0]), f32x4::splat(s, MF[0][1]), f32x4::splat(s, MF[0][2]), f32x4::splat(s, MF[0][3])),
359                single_weight(fract, f32x4::splat(s, MF[1][0]), f32x4::splat(s, MF[1][1]), f32x4::splat(s, MF[1][2]), f32x4::splat(s, MF[1][3])),
360                single_weight(fract, f32x4::splat(s, MF[2][0]), f32x4::splat(s, MF[2][1]), f32x4::splat(s, MF[2][2]), f32x4::splat(s, MF[2][3])),
361                single_weight(fract, f32x4::splat(s, MF[3][0]), f32x4::splat(s, MF[3][1]), f32x4::splat(s, MF[3][2]), f32x4::splat(s, MF[3][3])),
362            ]
363        },
364    )
365}
366
367/// Calculate a weight based on the fractional value t and the cubic coefficients.
368#[inline(always)]
369fn single_weight<S: Simd>(t: f32x4<S>, a: f32x4<S>, b: f32x4<S>, c: f32x4<S>, d: f32x4<S>) -> f32x4<S> {
370    t.mul_add(d, c).mul_add(t, b).mul_add(t, a)
371}
372
373/// Mitchell filter with the variables B = 1/3 and C = 1/3.
374const fn mf_resampler() -> [[f32; 4]; 4] {
375    cubic_resampler(1.0 / 3.0, 1.0 / 3.0)
376}
377
378/// Cubic resampling logic is borrowed from Skia. See
379/// <https://github.com/google/skia/blob/220fef664978643a47d4559ae9e762b91aba534a/include/core/SkSamplingOptions.h#L33-L50>
380/// for some links to understand how this works. In principle, this macro allows us to define a
381/// resampler kernel based on two variables B and C which can be between 0 and 1, allowing to
382/// change some properties of the cubic interpolation kernel.
383///
384/// As mentioned above, cubic resampling consists of sampling the 16 surrounding pixels of the
385/// target point and interpolating them with a cubic filter.
386/// The generated matrix is 4x4 and represent the coefficients of the cubic function used to
387/// calculate weights based on the `x_fract` and `y_fract` of the location we are looking at.
388const fn cubic_resampler(b: f32, c: f32) -> [[f32; 4]; 4] {
389    [
390        [(1.0 / 6.0) * b, -(3.0 / 6.0) * b - c, (3.0 / 6.0) * b + 2.0 * c, -(1.0 / 6.0) * b - c],
391        [1.0 - (2.0 / 6.0) * b, 0.0, -3.0 + (12.0 / 6.0) * b + c, 2.0 - (9.0 / 6.0) * b - c],
392        [(1.0 / 6.0) * b, (3.0 / 6.0) * b + c, 3.0 - (15.0 / 6.0) * b - 2.0 * c, -2.0 + (9.0 / 6.0) * b + c],
393        [0.0, 0.0, -c, (1.0 / 6.0) * b + c],
394    ]
395}

397#[cfg(any())]
398mod tests {
399    use super::*;
400    use crate::third_party::vello_common::fearless_simd::Fallback;
401
402    #[cfg(any())]
403    fn extend_overflow() {
404        let simd = Fallback::new();
405        let max = f32x4::splat(simd, 128.0);
406        let max_inv = 1.0 / max;
407
408        let num = f32x4::splat(simd, 127.00001);
409        let res = extend(simd, num, crate::third_party::vello_cpu::peniko::Extend::Repeat, max, max_inv);
410
411        assert!(res[0] <= 127.0);
412    }
413}
